failure_modes: A nonzero time_ramp_power (C005/C006) would apply a monotone dose schedule to a contrast whose observed-node direction reverses within the window, displacing surrounding coordinates along an unstable direction and risking secondary strain/validity without demonstrated affinity gain.

Changing native_rms_ratio away from the incumbent 0.33 would alter dose without evidence of advantage, since delivered_over_calibration is already fixed at 0.33 and no decoded terminal affinity outcome is supplied.
Treating the observed-node contrast curves as absolute reward targets or extrapolating them beyond [0.0,0.5] would be unsupported (polynomial_accepted false, extrapolation_allowed false).
Interpreting a temporal derivative as a spatial coordinate gradient would mis-specify the reward; the endpoint VJP is the only coordinate gradient.
result.rationale: D1.2: The offered choices are only dose scalars (native_rms_ratio C001-C003) and time_ramp_power (C004-C006). The incumbent already sits at native_rms_ratio 0.33 (C002) with time_ramp_power 0.0 (C004), so the only registered temporal alternative is a ramp exponent, which changes dose scheduling only; it does not change teacher coordinates or regional attention. Analyst's temporal evidence (F003/F004, H001/H002) shows the observed-node contrast curves are non-monotone with four to ten sign changes, opposing first/last rate z-values, polynomial_accepted false, extrapolation_allowed false and relative node RMSE 0.29-0.78. A monotone ramp exponent cannot express that reversal, and the curves are descriptive diagnostics over the observed window, not absolute reward targets. D4.1: No offered edit has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent; the incumbent's 0.33 ratio is already the middle registered dose and the delivered_over_calibration is pinned at 0.33 across all batches, so changing dose would not be evidence-driven. D4.2: The predicted failure of a ramp edit is unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates: a nonzero ramp power would up-weight late-window endpoint-VJP force, and since the observed contrast direction reverses within the window, that extra late dose would push surrounding coordinates along a direction the diagnostics show is not stable, risking strain and validity without any supplied affinity benefit. Affinity-first priority therefore favors retaining the incumbent. No temperature edit is proposed; temperatures are immutable.
